moments.title: Black Friday Week Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Retailers across the UK begin their Black Friday promotions this week, leading up to the main event on Friday, November 27th, and Cyber Monday on November 30th.

angles.name: Early Deals
angles.copy: Black Friday Week is officially underway! Who's already bagged a bargain and who's holding out for the big day on Friday? Let us know what you're hoping to snap up!

angles.name: Shopping Prep
angles.copy: Hands up if your Black Friday shopping list is longer than your Christmas list! Deals are starting to drop, so get ready for the biggest shopping weekend of the year. #BlackFridayWeek

moments.title: Liverpool Host Manchester United
moments.blurb: One of English football's fiercest rivalries takes centre stage today as Liverpool welcome Manchester United to Anfield for a 4:30 PM kick-off.

angles.name: Match Day Hype
angles.copy: It's the big one! Liverpool vs Man Utd at Anfield today. Who are you backing in this classic Premier League clash? #LIVMUN #PremierLeague

angles.name: Rivalry Talk
angles.copy: Nothing beats a Liverpool vs Man Utd match day! Expect fireworks, passion, and hopefully some incredible football. Tune in at 4:30 PM. #FootballIsBack

moments.title: Jungle Play Cardiff Tonight
moments.blurb: British electronic music duo Jungle bring their acclaimed live show to Utilita Arena Cardiff tonight, part of their UK tour.

angles.name: Cardiff Gig
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing tonight! @jungle4eva are taking over the Utilita Arena. Who's heading to see them live? Drop your favourite Jungle track!

angles.name: Welsh Music Scene
angles.copy: Big night for music in Wales! Jungle are bringing their unique sound to Cardiff. It's going to be an epic show!

moments.title: Champions League Matchday 5
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League returns this week for Matchday 5, featuring key fixtures including Arsenal vs Borussia Dortmund and Man City vs Napoli on Tuesday, November 24th.

angles.name: Midweek Football
angles.copy: Champions League football is back midweek! Arsenal, Man City, Man Utd, and Aston Villa are all in action for Matchday 5. Who needs a win most?

angles.name: Big European Nights
angles.copy: Big European nights are calling! Matchday 5 of the Champions League brings crucial games for our English clubs. Get ready for some drama!

moments.title: Rita Ora Turns 36
moments.blurb: Chart-topping British singer and songwriter Rita Ora celebrates her 36th birthday on Thursday, November 26th.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the incredible Rita Ora! What's your go-to Rita track to get the party started?

angles.name: Music Star
angles.copy: Happy Birthday, Rita Ora! From 'Hot Right Now' to her latest hits, she always brings the energy. Celebrate with us by playing your favourite!

moments.title: Natasha Bedingfield is 45
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated British singer-songwriter Natasha Bedingfield, known for hits like 'Unwritten' and 'These Words', celebrates her 45th birthday on Thursday, November 26th.

angles.name: Unwritten Hits
angles.copy: It's Natasha Bedingfield's 45th birthday on Thursday! You know the words, let's sing along to 'Unwritten' at the top of our lungs! #NatashaBedingfield

angles.name: Throwback Pop
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the voice behind some of the best 00s anthems, Natasha Bedingfield! What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: Fleetwood Mac's John McVie Turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary bassist John McVie of Fleetwood Mac, a pivotal figure in rock history, celebrates his 81st birthday on Thursday, November 26th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only John McVie from Fleetwood Mac! His basslines are pure gold. What's your favourite Fleetwood Mac song?

angles.name: Fleetwood Mac Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible John McVie on his 81st birthday! A true rock legend. What's a Fleetwood Mac track that always gets you?

moments.title: Arsenal Host Manchester City
moments.blurb: A massive Premier League title clash sees Arsenal take on Manchester City at the Emirates Stadium on Sunday, November 29th, with a 4:30 PM kick-off.

angles.name: Title Decider
angles.copy: Could this be a title decider? Arsenal vs Manchester City on Sunday! Who's taking all three points in this huge Premier League showdown?

angles.name: Super Sunday
angles.copy: Super Sunday just got bigger! Arsenal vs Man City at 4:30 PM. Get ready for a football feast!

moments.title: Mariah Carey at The O2
moments.blurb: The Queen of Christmas, Mariah Carey, brings her festive spectacular to The O2 Arena in London on Monday, November 30th.

angles.name: Christmas Queen
angles.copy: It's almost time! Mariah Carey takes over The O2 on Monday for a night of festive magic. Who's got their tickets to see the Queen of Christmas?

angles.name: London's Festive Kick-off
angles.copy: London, get ready! Mariah Carey is bringing her iconic show to The O2 on November 30th. The ultimate way to kick off the festive season!

moments.title: Cyber Monday Hits
moments.blurb: The online shopping frenzy culminates with Cyber Monday on November 30th, offering a final chance for many to grab deals after Black Friday weekend.

angles.name: Last Chance Deals
angles.copy: Cyber Monday is here! If you missed out on Black Friday, this is your last big chance for some amazing online deals. What are you eyeing up?

angles.name: Online Shopping
angles.copy: Don't forget to check out the Cyber Monday deals! Perfect for finishing off that Christmas list (or treating yourself!). Happy shopping!

moments.title: Bette Midler is 81
moments.blurb: The iconic 'Divine Miss M', Bette Midler, celebrates her 81st birthday on Tuesday, December 1st.

angles.name: Divine Miss M
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the legendary Bette Midler! From Broadway to 'The Rose', she's a true entertainer. What's your favourite Bette moment?

angles.name: Celebrating a Legend
angles.copy: Raise a glass to the incredible Bette Midler, turning 81 on Tuesday! Her voice and wit are timeless. What's the first song you think of when you hear her name?

moments.title: Janelle Monáe Turns 41

angles.name: Future-Funk Queen
angles.copy: Happy 41st Birthday to the incredible Janelle Monáe! A true innovator in music and style. What's your favourite track from her?

angles.name: Music & Style Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the multi-talented Janelle Monáe on her birthday! Her music always makes you move. Give us your top Janelle Monáe song!

moments.title: Christmas Songs Invade the Charts Early
moments.blurb: Festive favourites like Mariah Carey's 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' and Wham!'s 'Last Christmas' have already begun their annual climb back up the UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Too Early for Xmas?
angles.copy: It's only November, but the Christmas songs are already back in the charts! Are you secretly loving it, or is it way too soon? #ChristmasCreep

angles.name: Festive Chart Battle
angles.copy: Mariah vs. Wham! The annual battle for the Christmas No.1 has begun early this year, with both classics already re-entering the charts. Who are you backing?

moments.title: Phoebe Bridgers at The O2
moments.blurb: Indie-folk sensation Phoebe Bridgers performs at The O2 Arena in London on December 1st and 2nd, with special guests Isaac Wood and Anaïs.

angles.name: London Gigs
angles.copy: Phoebe Bridgers takes to The O2 stage on December 1st & 2nd! Who's excited to see the indie star live in London?

angles.name: Live Music
angles.copy: Don't miss Phoebe Bridgers at The O2 next week! Her intimate yet powerful performances are legendary. What's your favourite song to hear live?

moments.title: Gilbert O'Sullivan is 80

angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the brilliant Gilbert O'Sullivan! His songs have a unique charm that lasts generations. Which one is your all-time favourite?

angles.name: Pop Perfection
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring talent of Gilbert O'Sullivan, turning 80 on Tuesday! An absolute master of melody and lyrics. What's your most loved track from him?
